source_span: So the $n$th term, which is defined to be the sum of the first $n-1$ terms, is \[\underbrace{2^{n-3}}_{\text{sum of first }n-2\text{ terms}}+\underbrace{2^{n-3}}_{(n-1)\text{st term}}=2\cdot2^{n-3}=2^{n-2}.\]   This completes the induction step, so the statement is proved for all $n\geq 2$.
